# Without -o the emitted image is the payload on standard output —
# canonical JSON, byte-identical to what -o writes — and stderr stays
# silent. The golden section is the emitted image itself, locked in;
# -update rewrites it when the format deliberately moves.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

exec go mod edit -replace=github.com/modern-engineering/prototype=$SDLREPO
cp $SDLREPO/go.sum go.sum
sdl build
! stderr .
cmp stdout want-image.json
sdl build -o out.json
cmp out.json want-image.json

-- go.mod --
module example.test/sol

go 1.25.0

require github.com/modern-engineering/prototype v0.0.0
-- greet.sdl --
solution greet

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Ping as Ping1 {
	params {
		count: 1
		target: "pong"
	}
}
